exposure: family history of diabetes (in parents or grandparents)
outcome: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM-1 treated with diet)
Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM-2 treated with insulin)
cohort: A group of 912 women without chronic diseases, recruited in the first trimester of pregnancy.
finding: Family history of diabetes (paternal, maternal, and grandmaternal) is an independent risk factor for GDM-1 and GDM-2, with this risk being amplified in pregnant women with higher pre-pregnancy BMI categories.
